title: 湿りびとの市、昏き灯の街
author: 深山 霧子

en.title: The Damp City of the Suffering, the Street of Dim Lights
en.premise: A city forever cloaked in mist, where night never ends. Within it lies a "Memory Market" where people trade painful memories for sweet dreams. The protagonist, having returned to his hometown, discovers fragments of a lost memory in the scent of rotting flowers drifting through the market and the sticky footsteps that cling to the ground. Yet selling memories is synonymous with offering a part of oneself into an abyssal mire.

zh.title: 湿人之城，昏灯之街
zh.premise: 雾气常在、夜不曾破晓的城市。这里有一座“记忆市场”，人们以痛苦的记忆为代价，购买甜美的梦。主人公归乡后，在市场漂浮的腐烂花香与粘稠的脚步声中，找到了曾经失去的某段记忆碎片。然而，卖记忆等同于将自己的一部分投入无底的泥沼。
